PRODUCTION transparent 3x3 sprite animation atlas, nine equal separated cells, no text/grid/arrows/background/glow/cast shadow. Clean hand-painted 2D RTS art, fixed frontal three-quarter overhead view, upper-left light, restrained outlines, warm tan dry woody stems and crisp matte green leaves. Redesign the bean species into a FRIENDLY SIMPLE PLANT STRUCTURE. Avoid swollen ivory flesh, hanging skin, sagging membrane, paired round sacs, anatomical forms, fleshy ribbons, root tentacles, tooth-like bases or liquid shine. Plants should read as dry stems and leaves. All sources must have complete hidden contours for clean assembly. Reference image is only the bean species identity: tiny two-leaf shoot and mild green palette. Create a modest temporary FIELD HEADQUARTERS, like a small hastily grown leaf lean-to. One thin slightly asymmetrical folded green leaf awning on two straight slim tan woody posts. A low short rear wicker panel, empty inside. NO grand curved columns, no thick tub rim, no eggs, no gems, no centerpiece, no fancy flower tower. A small dry compact earth platform is its floor. Floor CENTER is directly below the CENTER of the canopy; both posts stand on opposite sides of this same floor, not forward of it. Symmetric support positions despite an asymmetrical leaf outline.
ROW 1 three COMPLETE drawings at the same fixed floor center:
1) Completed OPEN empty headquarters with its floor.
2) Same headquarters, front temporarily closed by TWO THIN FLAT RECTANGULAR LEAF SHUTTERS with a straight vertical center seam. These are flat leaves on a wooden doorway, not bulging membranes.
3) Half-grown structure: a SINGLE angular folded leaf bud becomes the awning and the two dry stems are beginning to rise, grounded at that same floor center.
ROW 2 isolated independent layers matching pose 1:
4) ONLY the low plain rear wicker panel, no ground or floor.
5) ONLY the thin green leaf roof, fully drawn underside and attachment contours. One small two-leaf shoot on top is allowed.
6) ONLY the left straight slim tan woody post, hidden top included.
ROW 3:
7) ONLY matching right post.
8) ONLY a plain thin straight front threshold plank, not curved, no roots.
9) ONLY one narrow horizontal wooden roof brace.
Do not put any floor into source parts 4–9. The common ground platform is a separate animation layer. All nine cells have generous transparent padding, all parts completely detached from other cells. Keep all materials matte, dry and simple.

THREE construction stages: small bean settling with flat resting eyelids; a single broad folded LEAF BUD at two-cell size; a simple three-cell dry-stem leaf shelter with flat leaf shutters. No paired swollen seed lobes or deep anatomical split.
ROW 1 COMPLETE key drawings:
1) Familiar squat pale bean on a compact flat earth platform, eyes closed as nearly STRAIGHT horizontal dark green strokes; sprout folded down. Mouthless, no legs or feet.
2) A SINGLE broad low folded green leaf bud: three crisp overlapping leaves loosely shelter a small cream core. A flat fold-over bud, not a tall point. No face, no twin bulges, no hanging sacs, no deep center cleft. Matte leaf veins, distinct mutated structure.
3) Small simple dry-stem headquarters: thin green leaf canopy, two straight woody posts, compact earth floor, flat rectangular leaf shutters closed at center.
ROW 2 independent parts:
4) ONLY the complete settled bean body from pose 1, no floor.
5) ONLY the complete broad folded LEAF BUD body from pose 2, no floor. Width about twice its height.
6) ONLY the floor: one flat compact tan earth oval/octagonal platform with a thin simple dry wooden border, about 3.3 times wider than tall. NO roots, fingers, grass fringe, loose objects or upright features. One connected solid clean shape. Its geometric CENTER must be clearly at its image center.
ROW 3 independent parts:
7) ONLY a THIN FLAT RECTANGULAR green leaf doorway shutter, LEFT half, straight vertical seam on RIGHT. Straight bottom, slightly rounded corners, subtle straight veins. No convex round belly, no drooping lip.
8) ONLY matching RIGHT flat shutter, seam on LEFT.
9) ONLY a pair of nearly perfectly STRAIGHT horizontal dark green resting eyelids.
Transparent between cells, no scenery or ground shadows. Source parts 5–8 must be dry clean leaf/wood architecture without anatomy. The first-stage bean retains its original soft body.

Production animation SOURCE PARTS, exactly TWO isolated thin dry woody posts on a true transparent background. Two columns, one row, generous empty gap. Match the tan bark, matte painted style and green leaf ties of the reference plant shelter. These replace the two detached columns in its source atlas. LEFT: a LONG SLENDER straight post, total height SEVEN times shaft diameter. RIGHT: a SHORTER straight post, total height FIVE times shaft diameter. Same shaft diameter for both. Full flat cut top cap, hidden upper shaft, one very small green leaf binding close to top, complete grounded bottom. Straight upright rigid woody stems, no swelling or roots. No floor, roof, backdrop, glow, shadows, text or labels. The posts will be placed directly beneath the small brown attachment caps on the leaf roof. Make their top caps proportionately small like those roof caps, not fat logs. Dry warm tan stems, no ivory flesh or wet shine. Do not draw the entire shelter.
